name: Max Estate 360 Residences
summary: Developer (Max Estates), Sector 36A Dwarka Expressway location, RERA GGM/860/592/2024/87, under-construction status, August 2030 possession, 11.8 acres, 6 towers and the 2149-3531 sq ft unit mix are all confirmed. Starting price of Rs 5.2 Cr is within range of portal quotes (Rs 5.32-5.48 Cr), though some sites quote Rs 7 Cr. Unit count is disputed: 864 on several sites vs 630 on others; the promoter entity name 'Max Estates Gurgaon Ltd.' was not independently confirmed.
